mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id, c.hyperlink_task_id AS task_id FROM hyperlink_task_recipient_claim c INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime r ON r.hyperlink_task_id=c.hyperlink_task_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id LEFT JOIN hyperlink_billing_reservation b ON b.hyperlink_task_id=c.hyperlink_task_id AND b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE r.provision_status=1 AND c.claim_status IN (1,2,3) AND (c.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR c.lease_expires_at<UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))*1000.0) AND (COALESCE(b.pending_operation,0)=0 OR COALESCE(b.next_retry_at,0)<=UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))*1000.0) ORDER BY c.updated_at, c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.tenant_id, c.hyperlink_task_id AS task_id FROM hyperlink_task_recipient_claim c INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime r ON r.hyperlink_task_id=c.hyperlink_task_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id LEFT JOIN hyperlink_billing_reservation b ON b.hyperlink_task_id=c.hyperlink_task_id AND b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE ((c.claim_status=4 AND ((r.run_status=0 AND r.provision_status=1) OR r.run_status IN (2,4))) OR (c.claim_status=5 AND ((r.provision_status=1 AND r.run_status=0) OR (r.run_status IN (2,4) AND b.reservation_status<>5 AND (b.pending_operation IN (3,4) OR (b.pending_operation=0 AND b.reservation_status IN (3,4))))))) AND (COALESCE(b.pending_operation,0)=0 OR COALESCE(b.next_retry_at,0)<=UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))*1000.0) ORDER BY c.updated_at, c.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyperlink_task_recipient_claim (hyperlink_task_id, data_package_id, data_package_generation, claim_upper_phone_id, scan_cursor_phone_id, quoted_phone_count, claimed_phone_count, claim_status, version, started_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{hyperlinkTaskId}, #{dataPackageId}, #{dataPackageGeneration}, #{claimUpperPhoneId}, #{scanCursorPhoneId}, #{quotedPhoneCount}, 0, #{claimStatus}, 1, #{startedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task_recipient_claim SET scan_cursor_phone_id=#{cursor}, claimed_phone_count=claimed_phone_count+#{claimedDelta}, claim_status=CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, finished_at=CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND claim_status IN (1,2)

UPDATE hyperlink_task_recipient_claim SET data_package_id=#{entity.dataPackageId}, data_package_generation=#{entity.dataPackageGeneration}, claim_upper_phone_id=#{entity.claimUpperPhoneId}, scan_cursor_phone_id=0, quoted_phone_count=#{entity.quotedPhoneCount}, claimed_phone_count=0, claim_status=1, lease_owner=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, version=version+1, started_at=#{entity.startedAt}, finished_at=NULL, updated_at=#{entity.updatedAt} WHERE hyperlink_task_id=#{entity.hyperlinkTaskId} AND claim_status IN (5,7) AND version=#{expectedVersion}
